mapper.select: SELECT su.id AS value, su.realname AS text, su.realname AS title, su.realname AS label FROM sys_user_depart sud INNER JOIN sys_depart sd ON sud.dep_id = sd.id INNER JOIN sys_user su ON sud.user_id = su.id WHERE sd.depart_name = '教师'
mapper.delete: DELETE co, cr FROM cloud_computing_course co LEFT JOIN cloud_computing_course_resource cr ON cr.course_id = co.id WHERE co.id = #{courseId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cloud_computing_course AS a LEFT JOIN cloud_computing_class AS b ON a.id = b.course_id LEFT JOIN cloud_computing_class_student AS c ON b.id = c.class_id LEFT JOIN sys_user AS d ON c.student_id = d.username WHERE d.username = #{UserName}

SELECT a.id FROM cloud_computing_course a LEFT JOIN cloud_computing_class b ON a.id = b.course_id LEFT JOIN cloud_computing_class_student c ON b.id = c.class_id LEFT JOIN sys_user d ON c.student_id = d.username LEFT JOIN cloud_computing_student_learning_record e ON a.id = e.course_id WHERE d.username = #{UserName} AND e.learning_status IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.id HAVING COUNT(*) = SUM(CASE WHEN e.learning_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
SELECT c.id, c.course_name FROM cloud_computing_course c LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON c.teacher_id = u.ID WHERE c.teacher_id = #{UserId}

SELECT FLOOR(SUM(c.learning_time) / 3600) AS total_learning_time FROM cloud_computing_course a LEFT JOIN cloud_computing_class b ON a.id = b.course_id LEFT JOIN cloud_computing_class_student d ON d.class_id = b.id LEFT JOIN cloud_computing_student_learning_record c ON c.course_id = a.id AND c.update_by = d.student_id WHERE a.id = #{CourseId} AND a.teacher_id = #{UserId} AND c.learning_time IS NOT NULL

SELECT c.student_id FROM cloud_computing_course a LEFT JOIN cloud_computing_class b ON a.id = b.course_id LEFT JOIN cloud_computing_class_student c ON b.id = c.class_id LEFT JOIN cloud_computing_student_learning_record e ON a.id = e.course_id AND c.student_id = e.update_by WHERE a.id = #{CourseId} AND a.teacher_id = #{UserId} AND e.learning_status = 1 GROUP BY a.course_name, b.class_name, c.student_id
SELECT role_name FROM sys_role WHERE id = ( SELECT role_id FROM sys_user_role WHERE user_id = ( SELECT id FROM sys_user WHERE username = #{UserId} ) )
